ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the ground giving way

plain.li: The ground went soft under every step in my dream, and I walked all night without getting anywhere.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_WatchesFooting] I dreamt every stone on the path had a name, and I had to say each one before I could step on it.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_TapsTheRoof] I knocked on the roof of the dig in my dream, and the rock knocked back, slow and patient.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_IndoorsByDusk] The sun went down in my dream and the air filled with wings, and I ran for the door and the door kept moving.

warm.li: In my dream someone took my arm on the bad ground and walked me home, and I never saw their face.

blunt.li: Dreamt I fell. Didn't land. Woke up.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I could walk on anything, mud, ice, the river, and never slip once.

gloomy.li: The floor of the colony was thin as paper in my dream, and I could hear the dark underneath it.

cold.li: A dream about falling, which is unsurprising after the last few weeks.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the first fire

plain.li: We were all round one fire in my dream, more of us than there have ever been, and nobody had to sit at the back.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_FirstFire] I carried the ember from the first night's fire through a long dark house in my dream, and every hearth lit as I passed.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_BootsByTheFire] My boots were dry in my dream, and my feet were warm, and that was the whole dream, and it was wonderful.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_BoilsWater] The kettle sang in my dream and the water came out clear as glass, and I drank it and was well.

warm.li: Everyone I've ever shared a fire with was there last night, in the dream, passing round the cups.

blunt.li: Good fire, dry boots, a full cup. Nice dream.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the fire told us stories, and it knew all our names.

gloomy.li: The fire burned low in my dream, but it didn't go out, and I sat up with it till morning.

cold.li: A warm dream about a fire. I slept well, which is the useful part.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long road

plain.li: I walked a road in my dream that went between our colony and every other place I've ever been.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_LooksBack] In my dream the people at the other colony were waving from the end of the road, and I walked and walked and they stayed just as far.
[quirk:Rimfolk_Quirk_RoadSong] The strangers' song went on in my dream after they'd gone, and I knew all the verses, even the ones they never sang.

warm.li: Dreamt the road was full of people I love, all coming this way.

blunt.li: Long road. Kept walking. Didn't arrive.

cheerful.li: The road in my dream had a camp at every bend, and every camp had supper on.

gloomy.li: I looked back down the road in my dream and there was nobody on it.

cold.li: I dreamt of the road between the colonies. It was shorter than I think it is.
